question: Should OpenClaw accept a generic durable plugin `allowAlwaysKey` approval API now, and what stable non-sensitive scope may Skill Workshop use if it opts in?
rationale: Durable approval reuse suppresses future human prompts and exposes a plugin-facing security contract, so automation cannot choose the trust scope or product boundary safely.

options.title: Fix and accept durable approvals
options.body: Approve the generic API direction, require a stable owner and non-sensitive scope for Skill Workshop, and prove second-call reuse before merge.

options.title: Split the generic backend
options.body: Land the generic durable approval mechanism only after API review, while deferring Skill Workshop allow-always until its owner/audit model is ready.

options.title: Defer durable plugin approvals
options.body: Keep plugin approvals session-local for now and continue tracking durable approval semantics in the related approval design issues.

recommendation.title: Fix and accept durable approvals
recommendation.body: Approve the generic API direction, require a stable owner and non-sensitive scope for Skill Workshop, and prove second-call reuse before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle introduced the current plugin approval framework and is listed in repository contributor guidance for Core, Gateway, Security, and Agents.
